features.feature: New / Open / Open Recent / Close / Save / Save As / Duplicate / Rename / Move To / Revert
features.apple: Edit.nib: File menu (New, Open…, Open Recent, Close, Save, Save As…, Duplicate, Revert to Saved)
features.note: SDK DocumentController::file_menu (springboard/sdk/src/document.rs:822) supplies the standard items.

features.apple: Edit.nib: File > Save All
features.note: File > Save All (cmd+alt+s) saves every edited document; untitled ones each open their save panel. Not checked on the lab machine.
features.wire: Verify Save All on Midget with multiple edited documents, including separate save panels for untitled documents.

features.apple: Info.plist CFBundleDocumentTypes: RTF (Editor)
features.note: RTF subset: fonts, char + paragraph formatting, tab width.

features.apple: Info.plist CFBundleDocumentTypes: plain text (Editor)
Info.plist CFBundleDocumentTypes: HTML (Editor)
features.note: Read and write via html.rs.

features.apple: Info.plist: RTFD (Editor); Localizable: RTFD save notices
features.note: Not done. RTFD is a folder package (TXT.rtf plus the attachment files), and the SDK document controller reads and writes one byte stream per document. Needs an SDK folder-package document type and an inline attachment cell in text.rs.
features.wire: Add an SDK folder-package document type, then an RTFD reader and writer in rtfd.rs with an attachment cell kind in text.rs.

features.feature: Word .docx / .doc / Word XML / ODT / web archive
features.apple: Info.plist CFBundleDocumentTypes: Word 2007/2003 XML/97, OpenDocument Text, Web archive
features.note: .docx, .odt and web archives (.webarchive: the page's HTML as the main resource of a binary property list) open and save. Not done: .doc (the binary Word 97 format), Word 2003 XML, pictures, tables, and headers and footers in the packages; .odt has no page break form, so a page break is written as a line break. Not yet verified on Midget.
features.wire: Word 2003 XML: a WordprocessingML reader and writer beside docx.rs (the element names are close). .doc needs its own binary reader, which is a separate piece of work.

features.feature: Plain text encodings (open/save encoding accessory, customize list)
features.apple: EncodingAccessory.nib, SelectEncodingsPanel.nib; Localizable: encoding errors, Customize Encodings List
features.note: Plain text opens in its own encoding and saves in the document encoding. Format > Text Encoding and Reinterpret As work; Preferences > Customize Encodings List chooses the encodings the Text Encoding menu lists (the document's own encoding is always listed). Still missing: the encoding accessory in the open and save panels, because the SDK panels take no accessory view. Not yet verified on Midget.
features.wire: The encoding popup in the open and save panels needs an accessory view in the SDK panels (the shell does not provide one yet).

features.apple: Edit.nib: File > Export as PDF…
features.note: File > Export as PDF... asks through a save panel and writes the same PDF the printer gets. Not checked on the lab machine.
features.wire: Verify the exported PDF on Midget opens and includes the same page content as the print path.

features.apple: Edit.nib: File > Page Setup…, Print…; PrintAccessory: header and footer, rewrap to fit page
features.note: File > Print Header and Footer (the title top left, "Page n of m" bottom right) and File > Rewrap to Fit Page are checked items. With rewrap off the lines print where the window breaks them, scaled down to the page width. Not checked on the lab machine.
features.wire: Verify header/footer and rewrap toggles on Midget with short and overlong lines; check a real print queue when available.

features.feature: Show/Hide document properties (author, title, subject, keywords, copyright)
features.apple: DocumentProperties.nib; Localizable: Show/Hide Properties, Change Author/Title/…
features.note: File > Show Properties opens a panel with title, author, subject, keywords and copyright. They are kept in the RTF info group, the .docx and .odt package metadata and, now, in the head of HTML files (the title element and meta elements). Still missing: the creation and modification dates the reference panel lists; no date is read from or written to a file yet.
features.wire: Read the creation and modification dates (docx core properties, odt metadata, the RTF creation time), write the modified time on save, and show both in the panel's title row.

features.apple: Edit.nib: Edit > Undo, Redo
features.note: Named undo actions.

features.apple: Edit.nib: Edit > Cut, Copy, Paste, Select All
Edit.nib: Edit > Paste and Match Style
features.note: Edit > Paste and Match Style (cmd+alt+shift+v) pastes plain text in the style at the caret. Edit > Paste keeps the formatting of text copied in this document (the app keeps its own copy next to the system clipboard text). Rich content copied from another app is pasted as plain text. Not checked on the lab machine.
features.wire: Rich content from other apps needs an RTF pasteboard type in the SDK (the general pasteboard carries plain text here).

features.feature: Delete / Complete / Insert (page break, line break, paragraph break)
features.apple: Edit.nib: Edit > Delete, Complete, Insert submenu
features.note: Edit > Delete, Complete and Insert (Page Break, Line Break, Paragraph Break) work. A line break read from HTML (br) or .odt (text:line-break) is a line break inside the paragraph again, not a new paragraph; HTML keeps the page break. .odt writes a page break as a line break. Not yet verified on Midget.
features.wire: A page break in .odt as a paragraph break-before style, which needs an automatic paragraph style in odt.rs.

features.apple: Edit.nib: Edit > Attach Files…, Link…
features.note: Edit > Add Link (Cmd+K), Open Link and Remove Link link text to a web, mail, phone or file transfer address (links.rs); links are drawn in the link colour with an underline, kept by RTF hyperlink fields, HTML anchors, docx hyperlinks and odt anchors, printed, and followed by a click in a document that cannot be edited. Attachments (files and pictures in the text) are not done. built on parity/team-d-textedit; not yet verified on Midget.
features.wire: Attachments need an inline attachment cell kind in text.rs, drawing in view.rs and the RTFD package; a click on a link in an editable document needs the modifier state in touch events.

features.feature: Find, Find Next/Previous, Replace, Replace All
features.apple: Edit.nib: Edit > Find submenu
features.note: Find bar with replace.

features.feature: Use Selection for Find / Jump to Selection
features.apple: Edit.nib: Edit > Find > Use Selection for Find, Jump to Selection
features.note: Edit > Find > Use Selection for Find (cmd+E) puts the selection on the find pasteboard and fills the find field; the find field takes the find pasteboard's text when the find bar opens. Jump to Selection (cmd+J) scrolls the caret into view. Not checked on the lab machine.
features.wire: Verify Use Selection for Find populates the find field and Jump to Selection scrolls the caret into view on Midget.

features.feature: Spelling: check now, while typing, learn, ignore, correct
features.apple: Edit.nib: Edit > Spelling and Grammar
features.note: Check Document Now, Check Spelling While Typing, Correct Spelling Automatically, Correct Spelling, Learn, Ignore, and Show Spelling and Grammar (a panel that steps through the misspelled words with Ignore, Learn, Change and Find Next). Still missing: grammar checking.
features.wire: Grammar checking needs a grammar checker in the SDK, which does not exist yet.

features.feature: Substitutions (smart quotes, dashes, links, text replacement, data detectors)
features.apple: Edit.nib: Edit > Substitutions; Preferences.nib: Smart quotes/dashes/links
features.note: Smart Quotes, Smart Dashes, Smart Links and Text Replacement are on the Substitutions submenu and kept in the preferences. Text Replacement turns a fixed list of shortcuts (such as (c), ... and 1/2, replace.rs) into their symbols when a blank ends the word; the desktop's own replacement list is not read. Data detectors are not done.
features.wire: Read the desktop's replacement list through the text services (replacements) so the list is the one the user keeps; data detectors (dates and addresses to links) remain.

features.apple: Edit.nib: Edit > Transformations
features.note: Edit > Transformations: Make Upper Case, Make Lower Case and Capitalize act on the selection as one undo entry (text.rs transformations_change_case_in_one_undo). Not yet verified on Midget.
features.wire: Verify all three text transformations on Midget and confirm each operation is undone as one step.

features.apple: Edit.nib: Edit > Speech > Start/Stop Speaking
features.note: Start Speaking speaks the selection, else the whole document, through the shell speech service (espeak-ng). Stop Speaking ends it. The items sit in Text > Speech because the shell's Edit menu takes no app items. Host unit tests cover the service and the engine arguments; the menu wiring has no test.
features.wire: Verify on Midget with espeak-ng installed (speak, stop, the menu entries). Move the items under Edit once the shell lets an app add to Edit.

features.apple: Edit.nib: Format > Font > Bold, Italic, Underline
features.note: Also in format bar.

features.apple: Edit.nib: Format > Font > Outline, Kern, Ligatures, Baseline
features.note: Strikethrough, Superscript and Subscript are character styles (RTF \strike \super \sub, HTML s/sup/sub, docx, odt, print). Outline, Kern and Ligatures are not done.
features.wire: Add strikethrough and super/subscript flags to the cell style in text.rs, RTF \strike \super \sub in rtf.rs, draw in view.rs; Format > Font items.

features.feature: Font family and size (Bigger/Smaller, Show Fonts)
features.apple: Edit.nib: Format > Font > Show Fonts, Bigger, Smaller
features.note: Fixed list of the three built-in families (text::FAMILIES) and step sizes; no font panel with all system fonts. Preferences > Default Font sets the family new text takes.
features.wire: Replace the families submenu with the SDK font panel (Cmd+T) listing installed fonts; store the family name in cells.

features.apple: Edit.nib: Format > Font > Show Colours, Highlight
features.note: Format > Highlight sets a background colour from the palette (RTF \highlight, docx, odt, print). The colour panel for custom colours is not done.
features.wire: Add a highlight (background colour) attribute in text.rs with RTF \highlight/\cb; open SDK colour panel for custom colours.

features.apple: Edit.nib: Format > Font > Copy Style, Paste Style
features.note: Format > Copy Style (cmd+alt+c) keeps the caret's character and paragraph formatting. Paste Style (cmd+alt+v) applies both to the selection (or the typing style and the paragraph at the caret) as one undo entry. Not checked on the lab machine.
features.wire: Verify character and paragraph style copy/paste on Midget for both a selection and a caret insertion point.

features.apple: Edit.nib: Format > Text > Align Left/Centre/Justify/Right
Edit.nib: Format > Text > Spacing…
features.note: Format > Text > Spacing... sets the line spacing (a number from 1 to 3, the nearest preset is kept) and the space before and after each paragraph in points. The space is kept in RTF (sb and sa), in HTML (margins), in .docx (w:before, w:after) and in .odt (fo:margin-top and fo:margin-bottom), with unit tests in docx.rs and odt.rs, and laid out and printed. Line spacing is one of the presets, not any multiple. Not yet verified on Midget.
features.wire: Arbitrary line multiples need a fractional value in Style.spacing; the presets are the only line spacing kept today.

features.apple: Edit.nib: Format > List…
features.note: Bullets and numbers only; no list styles/prefix/start number.
features.wire: Add a List… sheet choosing marker style and start number; extend ListKind in text.rs.

features.apple: Edit.nib: Format > Table…
features.note: Audit 2026-10-13: kit model ui/src/text_table.rs (host tests) already provides this; the app does not use it yet.
features.wire: Add table blocks to the text model and RTF \trowd; lay out with bifrost_ui::text_table.

features.apple: Edit.nib: Format > Text > Writing Direction
features.note: Format > Text > Left to Right and Right to Left set the paragraph direction on the selected paragraphs (one undo entry); a right to left paragraph's left-aligned lines start at the right edge, and the direction is kept in RTF (\rtlpar) and in .docx (w:bidi) and .odt (style:writing-mode), with unit tests. Not done: the direction in HTML, and the bidi reordering of mixed-direction runs (the kit model ui/src/bidi.rs is not used by the app yet). Tested in text.rs and layout.rs unit tests; not yet verified on Midget.
features.wire: Run bifrost_ui::bidi visual order in layout.rs for mixed runs; carry the direction in html.rs (dir).

features.apple: Edit.nib: Format > Text > Show Ruler, Copy Ruler, Paste Ruler; Preferences: Show ruler
features.note: View > Show Ruler (cmd+r) toggles the ruler and is kept in the preferences. Format > Text > Copy Ruler and Paste Ruler copy and apply the tab stop distance. Still missing: the first-line and left indent markers on the ruler.
features.wire: Indent markers need per-paragraph indent properties in text.rs and layout.rs, and drag handles on the ruler in view.rs.

features.feature: Make Plain Text / Make Rich Text
features.apple: Edit.nib: Format > Make Plain Text; Localizable: conversion confirms
features.note: No confirm when plain conversion loses formatting.

features.apple: Edit.nib: Format > Prevent Editing / Allow Editing
features.note: Format > Prevent Editing / Allow Editing sets read_only on the window document: typing, deleting, paste, undo, replace, transformations, formatting and the panels that change the document refuse with a status note. It is not stored in the file. Not checked on the lab machine.
features.wire: Verify read-only mode blocks edits, undo and formatting on Midget, and Allow Editing restores input.

features.feature: Wrap to Page / Wrap to Window
features.apple: Edit.nib: Format > Wrap to Page; Localizable: Wrap to Window
features.note: Format > Wrap to Page and View > Wrap to Window toggle the text column width (the window or the readable width); kept in the preferences.
features.wire: Verify both wrap modes change the text column as expected and persist across relaunch on Midget.

features.apple: Edit.nib: Format > Allow Hyphenation
features.note: Audit 2026-10-13: kit model ui/src/textbreak.rs (host tests) already provides this; the app does not use it yet.
features.wire: Use bifrost_ui::textbreak line-break opportunities plus soft hyphens in layout.rs.

features.apple: Edit.nib: Format > Make Vertical Layout
features.note: CJK vertical text layout; out of scope for current text stack.

features.apple: Edit.nib: View > Zoom In, Zoom Out, Actual Size
features.note: View > Zoom In (cmd+alt+=), Zoom Out (cmd+alt+-) and Actual Size (cmd+0) scale the text 50% to 400% (sizes are scaled for layout and drawing; the page width stays). Not checked on the lab machine.
features.wire: Verify zoom bounds, shortcuts and Actual Size on Midget, including layout at the smallest and largest supported sizes.

features.feature: Full screen and dark background for windows
features.apple: Edit.nib: View > Enter Full Screen, Use Dark Background for Windows
features.note: View > Use Dark Background for Windows: the page is dark and text with no colour of its own is white; kept in the preferences. Full screen is the window chrome of the shell, not the app, so the app has nothing to add.
features.wire: Verify dark page background and automatic white text on Midget; full-screen window behaviour is owned by the shell.

features.apple: SelectLinePanel.nib, LinePanel strings
features.note: Edit > Find > Select Line... (cmd+L) opens a panel for a line number or a range such as 12-20; Select selects those lines, and a line the document does not have keeps the panel open with the number of lines.
features.wire: Verify selecting a line and range on Midget and that an out-of-range entry keeps the panel open with its validation message.

features.feature: Settings: new document format, window size, fonts
features.apple: Preferences.nib: New Document tab (format, wrap to page, window size, fonts)
features.note: Preferences (cmd+,) opens a panel with the new document format (rich or plain), the default font and the plain text encoding. Window size in characters is not done: the window size belongs to the shell.
features.wire: Window size is a shell window setting, not an app setting; not planned for the app.

features.feature: Settings: open and save options (HTML/RTF as code, encodings, HTML saving, .txt extension)
features.apple: Preferences.nib: Open and Save tab
features.note: Preferences: Show RTF and HTML Files as Code, Plain Text Encoding and Customize Encodings List. Still missing: the HTML saving options (document type, style sheet or inline styles) and the add-.txt-extension option.
features.wire: HTML saving: a document type and a style-sheet mode in html.rs write, chosen in the preferences; add-.txt: a preference the save path applies to the suggested name.

features.apple: Preferences.nib: Options (check spelling as you type, grammar, correct automatically, smart quotes/dashes/links)
features.note: Check Spelling While Typing, Correct Spelling Automatically, Smart Quotes, Smart Dashes, Smart Links, Text Replacement, the ruler, wrapping, the header and footer, rewrap and the dark background are listed in the Preferences panel and saved to the preferences.
features.wire: Verify preference toggles persist across relaunch on Midget and affect spelling, substitutions, wrapping and print defaults as described.

features.feature: Services: new window with selection / open selected file
features.apple: Info.plist NSServices: New window containing selection; Open selected file
features.note: No services provider. The shell's Services list (springboard/ui/src/services_menu.rs) is fixed, and the document controller opens files only through the panel, so the two services need a shell change and a controller path that opens a named file.
features.wire: Add the two services to the shell's Services list, routed to a text intent that creates a document with the text or opens the named path; needs the SDK controller path.

features.apple: Edit.nib: Help > TextEdit Help
features.note: Apple help book content.
